notes.mixed_ink_location: mixed inks and mixed-ink groups are represented only in press-write inks.rs (Folio stores spot inks, StudioSpotInk, no mixed-ink record), so the 27/31/1000 limits are enforced there
notes.mixed_ink_total_note: with unique parts and only four process inks, a mixed ink of 32 parts always holds >= 28 spots; the 31-total refusal is counted first (mixed_ink_too_many_inks), so a 32-total case with <= 27 spots does not exist to test independently
notes.pdfx_design: no new ExportOptions field: hsk-studio-press src/preset.rs (outside owned paths) builds ExportOptions with a full struct literal, so a new field would break it; the standard is carried by ExportOptions::pdfx4 and read/written through the typed pdfx_standard / with_pdfx_standard; the identification written is this crate's PDF/X-4 one, labelled pdfx.x4_2010 (edition mapping UNVERIFIED, D5); no conformance claimed for any member
notes.spec_conflict_for_steward: press preset ComplianceCheck (STU-LAY-159, src/preset.rs) carries 'PDF/X-4:2007' while STU-LAY-160 enumerates pdfx.x4_2010; layout pdf_export_prefs STANDARDS_COMPLIANCE_KNOWN carries the same STU-LAY-159 tokens. Not unified here (outside paths); propose a spec note on which edition the X-4 member names
notes.brief_vs_spec: the brief names 'the four booleans'; STU-LAY-161 names three switches (convert-all-text-to-outlines, convert-all-strokes-to-outlines, clip-complex-regions) plus the raster-vector balance; three implemented, no fourth invented
notes.flattener_level_placement: FlattenerLevel is the STU-LAY-135 spread_flattener_override vocabulary; the preset carries it as level: Option<FlattenerLevel>; no mapping from a level to parameter values is invented (none captured)
